Each taco is probably a small 15 cm tortilla, which is about 35 g. The filling is roughly 50-60 g of meat plus about 25 g of toppings. That puts each taco at around 110-120 g, so the two together are about 230 g.

Energy per taco: tortilla about 90 kcal, meat about 120 kcal, cheese and veg about 30 kcal. That is roughly 240 kcal each, or about 480 kcal for both.
